articles.headline: The Dutch-born quartet who are one win away from reaching the Olympics -- with Indonesia
articles.description: A Dutch-born quartet are a win away from realising their Olympic dream -- but it could just be with Indonesia.

images.name: 2023 AFC Asian Cup - Japan vs. Indonesia: Ivar Jenner; Justin Hubner; Rafael Struick [1296x729]
images.caption: Having been part of the side that helped Indonesia reach the knockout round of the AFC Asian Cup for the first time earlier this year, the Dutch-born trio of Ivar Jenner, Justin Hubner and Rafael Struick are now gunning for Olympic qualification.

images.name: 2024 AFC U-23 Asian Cup - Uzbekistan vs. Indonesia: Nathan Tjoe-A-On [1296x729]
images.caption: Despite losing to Uzbekistan in the AFC U-23 Asian Cup semifinals, Indonesia remain one win away from reaching the Paris Olympics -- either in Thursday's third-place match with Iraq or an intercontinental qualifier against Guinea.

images.name: 2024 AFC U-23 Asian Cup - South Korea vs. Indonesia: Rafael Struick [1296x729]
images.caption: Rafael Struick played a starring role in the AFC U-23 Asian Cup quarterfinals with two crucial goals in a 2-2 draw against South Korea, which ultimately saw Indonesia prevail 11-10 in a marathon penalty shootout.

articles.headline: Here's how a soccer club can make a match climate neutral
articles.description: Dutch club FC Dordrecht concluded their season with a climate-neutral match to demonstrate the feasibility of sustainable sporting events.

articles.headline: Free beer! PEC Zwolle legend Bram van Polen's latest contract clause: a drink for every fan
articles.description: PEC Zwolle captain Bram van Polen likes to have fun with his contract "demands," and the deal securing his 17th season at the club is no exception.

articles.headline: Dutch league plans one-minute protest against racism
articles.description: Players in the top two divisions of Dutch football will stand still for the first minute of matches this weekend as a protest against racism.

articles.headline: Racially abused Excelsior winger Moreira labelled 'pathetic little man' by opposition manager
articles.description: Excelsior's Ahmad Mendes Moreira, who was subjected to racial abuse Sunday, was called a "pathetic little man" by Den Bosch boss Erik Van der Ven.
